title: Array Parameter Validation
query: Add tags: urgent, customer-request, and bug to this ticket

tags.description: Tags to add (lowercase, alphanumeric and hyphens only)

explanation: Array validation has multiple constraints: (1) Array format: ['item1', 'item2', 'item3'], (2) Item pattern: lowercase, alphanumeric, hyphens only, (3) minItems: 1 (at least one), (4) maxItems: 10 (max ten). The user provided 3 tags already in valid format. Key: all items must match the pattern. If user said 'Customer Request' (with space/caps), you'd need to convert to 'customer-request'.
learning_points: Arrays have: type validation, item count constraints, item format rules
Each array item must match the 'items' schema
Convert user input to match constraints: spaces → hyphens, uppercase → lowercase
